title: Karnataka Government Employees Health Scheme Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Healthcare support for eligible Karnataka state government employees and covered dependants.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible Karnataka government employees and dependants under current state employee health rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Karnataka Government Employees Health Scheme.

nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
